text_block_list.text:
I'm watching some Umamusume train,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Blue skies, a nice breeze... It's
going to
be a great day! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could run forever! Wherever
the wind
takes me. ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Really now? I was wondering who was
making all
that noise, but to think it was
you, Fine.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ah! Groove!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to be training. Where
do you
think you're going?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Well, if you're curious...
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
I just found a bunch of clovers growing
by the
track over there!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: ...And?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
They look so nice! I feel like my runs
have just
become three times as fun! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! You like flowers, right,
Groove?
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Why don't you come with me? We can
look for
four-leaf clovers together! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Just focus on your training!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You know the kinds of speeds we can
get up to.
You'll hurt yourself if you
don't watch the track!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh... So you were acting so stern out of
concern.
That's so sweet of you,
Groove! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
...No. I'm telling you to stop goofing
around and
focus!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Huh? But it'd be a shame to not have
fun, training
or not!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Don't you agree? I'm talking to you over
there!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Running with a friend is even more fun.
It's important to train and have fun!

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! Groove, mind taking a
run with
me? ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll show you where the clovers are and
race you
while we're at it! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Only if you take it seriously. If you're not
one
hundred percent in it, you'll lose.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll do anything as long as it's
fun! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: Aww... You sound just like Groove!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
It's not "just like" me, it's exactly what I
said. If
you don't take training seriously,
you'll never win.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Let me see if you have enough guts to
pass me!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: To pass you? You mean...
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: Ah, okay! You want to play tag!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You can be "it" first, so try and catch me!
Here I
go! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: No, I just meant races in general...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Exactly! I want to make each training
session one
to remember!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Why don't I grab my
camera? I bet I
could take some really
dynamic shots!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
I'll go get set up on the sidelines. ♪ I'll
see you
around, Groove!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Fine! ...I can never keep up with
her.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. As long as you're going
to run
with everything you've got, I'll
play along.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув looks completely
exasperated as she
leaves the track, but
she stays with Fine Motion
for a while as
she photographs other trainees.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
